name: appdirect-mcp
description: Every documented AppDirect marketplace operation in one binary, plus offline sync and billing-reconciliation joins.

appdirect_client_id.title: APPDIRECT_CLIENT_ID
appdirect_client_id.description: Sets APPDIRECT_CLIENT_ID for the AppDirect MCP server.

appdirect_client_secret.title: APPDIRECT_CLIENT_SECRET
appdirect_client_secret.description: Sets APPDIRECT_CLIENT_SECRET for the AppDirect MCP server.

appdirect_oauth_scope.title: APPDIRECT_OAUTH_SCOPE
appdirect_oauth_scope.description: Sets APPDIRECT_OAUTH_SCOPE for the AppDirect MCP server. Required by the generated client for credential refresh or hand-written auth flow.

appdirect_base_url.title: AppDirect API base URL
appdirect_base_url.description: Base URL for the AppDirect API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

appdirect_token_url.title: OAuth2 token URL
appdirect_token_url.description: Token endpoint the client-credentials exchange posts to. Leave the prefilled default unless your tenant uses a different token endpoint.

appdirect_no_config_write.title: Keep credentials off disk
appdirect_no_config_write.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk. The token cache becomes a no-op, so the connector mints a fresh token each run instead of writing one to config.toml. Leave blank for the default cached behaviour.

appdirect_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only mode
appdirect_mcp_read_only.description: Set to 1 to make the MCP server refuse every write: only read tools are callable. Leave blank to allow writes (each MCP write still previews first and sends only when called again with confirm set to true).

appdirect_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
appdirect_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

appdirect_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
appdirect_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on AppDirect requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

appdirect_mcp_upload_root.title: MCP upload folder (optional)
appdirect_mcp_upload_root.description: Optional. Leave blank. Reserved for MCP file uploads: the AppDirect MCP server refuses every upload in this release (a user CSV, a catalog file, a product image or PDF) and names the CLI command to run instead, so the server never opens a local path and this setting has no effect.

appdirect_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
appdirect_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote or hosted deployment); at least 32 characters. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
